objective: GATE 3F-A R2 MPRO CANARY DESIGN DISCOVERY. Recovery minimo y determinista para decidir readiness del canary MPRO usando solo consultas simples ya compatibles con el auditor READ_ONLY. Resolver evidencia de Pc_ID, forma/estado, tablas hijas, lookup e indicador de saldo. Si Pc_ID sigue sin mecanismo autoritativo, certificar el blocker y NO autorizar canary. No escribir ni implementar Payment Executor.

queries.name: f3a_r2_runtime_identity
queries.sql: SELECT @@SERVERNAME AS server_name,DB_NAME() AS database_name,SUSER_SNAME() AS login_name,USER_NAME() AS database_user

queries.name: f3a_r2_pc_id_column
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable,c.is_identity,c.is_computed,dc.definition AS default_definition FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc ON dc.parent_object_id=c.object_id AND dc.parent_column_id=c.column_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') AND c.name=N'Pc_ID'

queries.name: f3a_r2_pc_id_frequency
queries.sql: SELECT Pc_ID,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Pc_ID ORDER BY total DESC,Pc_ID

queries.name: f3a_r2_form_state_shape
queries.sql: SELECT Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado,COUNT_BIG(*) AS total FROM dbo.Pago_CXP GROUP BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado ORDER BY Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,Es_Cve_Estado

queries.name: f3a_r2_child_comprobante_by_form
queries.sql: SELECT p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos,COUNT_BIG(c.Cxp_Folio) AS comprobantes_relacionados FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_Cxp_Comprobante c ON c.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND c.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID GROUP BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: f3a_r2_child_impuesto_by_form
queries.sql: SELECT p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago,COUNT_BIG(*) AS pagos,COUNT_BIG(i.Cxp_Folio) AS impuestos_relacionados FROM dbo.Pago_CXP p LEFT JOIN dbo.Pago_CXP_Impuesto i ON i.Cxp_Folio=p.Cxp_Folio AND i.Pc_ID=p.Pc_ID GROUP BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago ORDER BY p.Fp_Cve_Forma_Pago

queries.name: f3a_r2_cxp_confirmation_columns
queries.sql: SELECT c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.is_nullable FROM sys.columns c INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE c.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Cuenta_X_Pagar') ORDER BY c.column_id

queries.name: f3a_r2_pago_indexes
queries.sql: SELECT i.name AS index_name,i.is_unique,i.is_primary_key,ic.key_ordinal,c.name AS column_name FROM sys.indexes i INNER JOIN sys.index_columns ic ON ic.object_id=i.object_id AND ic.index_id=i.index_id INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=ic.object_id AND c.column_id=ic.column_id WHERE i.object_id=OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.Pago_CXP') ORDER BY i.index_id,ic.key_ordinal

queries.name: f3a_r2_candidate_sequences
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,q.name AS sequence_name,t.name AS data_type,q.start_value,q.increment,q.current_value FROM sys.sequences q INNER JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=q.schema_id INNER JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=q.user_type_id WHERE q.name LIKE N'%Pago%' OR q.name LIKE N'%CXP%' OR q.name LIKE N'%Pc%' ORDER BY s.name,q.name

constraints: NO INSERT UPDATE DELETE MERGE EXEC EXECUTE DDL SELECT INTO OR MULTI-STATEMENT SQL
NO individual provider, invoice or payment business rows beyond bounded Pc_ID code frequency and aggregate form/state evidence
Connections only through PosRuntimeResolver and get_external_sql_connection
Use prior certified Gate 3D and 3E evidence together with this R2
If Pc_ID authoritative generation is not proven, classify MPRO canary as BLOCKED_NOT_READY
Do not authorize child-table writes from correlation alone
Do not authorize any canary or Payment Executor writer
